name: ANTH 5321
title: Ethnographic Methods I
description: Theoretical foundations and basic tools used to conduct professional field studies in anthropology. Research design; moral and ethical dimensions of field work; designing and conducting informal, semi-structured and structured interviews (one-on-one and in groups); managing field notes, questionnaires, and data; computer data management; summary statistics and graphics; identifying and interpreting random variation; modeling and testing explanations. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
